thread:
Rohan (AM): Opening ZettaEdge POC: they want SAML SSO, SCIM bulk (~400k users), RBAC group->role mapping, domain proofing, and an on-prem air-gapped production option. Need blockers + pricing bands before next stakeholder meeting.
Dana (SE): Quick SCIM clarifying Qs: initial bulk + near-hourly deltas? Also what acceptable downtime for cutover? For 400k recommend chunks of 2k-5k and concurrency ~10-12.
Ivy (Eng): Implementation notes: use incremental lastModified deltas for hourly syncs; tombstone records for deletes. For 429s/503s use exponential backoff starting at 1s, max 60s, jitter.
Ivy (Eng): Recommendation for RBAC: SCIM groups -> roles for bootstrap and periodic sync; SAML role/attribute assertions for immediate enforcement at login. If they require realtime SCIM->session re-eval, provide webhooks but call out scale limits.
Marco (Infra): Air-gapped option specifics: we need full network diagram, host inventory, storage encryption details, and a signed SOW for no management-plane access. Support overhead adds ~15% uplift plus one-time deployment fee.
Rohan (AM): They project ~180 TPS peak for auth checks. How does that affect Dedicated sizing vs Hosted?
Dana (SE): 180 TPS sustained -> Dedicated reserved capacity recommended for predictable latency and cost. Suggest 2 reserved nodes steady-state + burst pool; include Hosted-fallback SKU for overflow routing.
legal-bot: legal-bot: note - customer-managed KMS requires DPA/KMS addendum. On-prem HSM demands chain-of-custody docs and audited transfer procedures.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: provisioning task zettaedge-onprem created -> status: waiting for IP allowlist (owner: infra)
Ivy (Eng): SCIM patch example (add members): ```json
{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"add","path":"members","value":[{"value":"user-42"}]}]}
```
Marco (Infra): Also confirm log export targets (syslog / Splunk / S3). If they require streaming audit logs to their SIEM, that adds network egress and retention considerations.
Rohan (AM): Action items: (1) Rohan - request network diagram, SAML metadata, QPS cert and log export targets; (2) Ivy - SCIM runbook + backoff params + sample configs; (3) Dana - pricing sketch (Dedicated reserved + Hosted fallback + air-gap uplift and one-time fee); (4) Marco - KMS/HSM checklist for Legal. Sync Fri AM. :thumbsup:
